Round-trip error of the baked grid against the live OCIO processor.

Method: 200000 pseudo-random ACEScct samples (seed 20260828), uniform in [0,1]^3 -- the
LUT's own domain, which is where the shader will fetch. Each sample is put
through (i) the live processor and (ii) trilinear interpolation of the baked
grid, exactly as the GPU sampler will do. Errors are in output code value,
i.e. the display-encoded [0,1] the LUT stores; 'cv8' scales that by 255 so
'below half a code value' means cv8 < 0.5.

-- identity, 33^3, trilinear vs exact

   p99  abs err = 0.00000000   (0.0000 8-bit code values)
